Fortifying Liberty’s Legacy.

A three-year professional learning initiative helping secondary history and civics teachers deepen disciplinary literacy, engage foundational documents, and use generative AI responsibly.

About the project

Strengthening civic learning through teachers.

Fortifying Liberty’s Legacy brings UCI researchers, historians, and educators together around high-quality history and civics instruction.

The initiative will provide professional learning for more than 400 secondary teachers. Its work connects close reading of foundational U.S. documents with disciplinary literacy strategies and thoughtful, evidence-based use of generative AI.

DurationThree years
EducatorsMore than 400 secondary teachers
Support$1.75 million from the U.S. Department of Education

Project priorities

History, literacy, and responsible technology.

Examine Foundational Texts

Teachers engage deeply with primary sources and the ideas that shape U.S. civic life.

Build Disciplinary Literacy

Professional learning supports the reading, reasoning, and evidence practices used by historians.

Use AI Responsibly

Educators investigate how generative AI can support instruction while preserving judgment and source evaluation.
